title: The 4 Best Leaf Blowers for Large Properties
h1: The 4 Best Leaf Blowers for Large Properties
metaDescription: Our 4 picks for leaf blowers for large properties, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at leaf blowers for large properties using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: EGO Power+ LB6504 650 CFM Cordless Leaf Blower
products.blurb: Key specs: 56V ARC Lithium battery, 5.0Ah included, Up to 650 CFM turbo airflow, Up to 75 minutes runtime per charge.
strengths: 650 CFM and up to 75 minutes of runtime cover most half-acre cleanups on one charge
Battery platform scales up to larger EGO batteries for extended jobs
5-year tool warranty holds up to frequent, heavy-duty use
Brushless motor stays consistent under sustained turbo use
limitations: Heaviest handheld pick here, which matters over a long session
Still lighter-duty than a true gas backpack blower for daily commercial use
features: Up to 75 minutes runtime per charge
Compatible with higher-capacity EGO batteries for longer runtime

products.name: Ryobi 40V HP Brushless Whisper Series 650 CFM Leaf Blower
products.blurb: Key specs: 40V HP Brushless motor, 650 CFM / 160 MPH, Whisper Series low-noise housing, Cruise control trigger lock.
strengths: Cruise control lock reduces hand fatigue over a long half-acre-plus session
650 CFM matches the EGO at a lower typical price for the bare tool
Lower noise output makes extended early-morning or evening sessions less disruptive
Large 40V battery options available for extended runtime
limitations: Bare tool listings mean battery and charger are often a separate purchase
1-year tool warranty versus the EGO's 5-year coverage
Slightly less consistent Amazon availability than Home Depot in-store
features: Turbo button for maximum clearing power
Shares Ryobi's wide 40V outdoor tool battery platform

products.name: Greenworks 40V 185 MPH 340 CFM Cordless Blower/Vacuum
products.blurb: Key specs: 185 MPH / 340 CFM brushless motor, 2-in-1 blower and vacuum with collection bag, Includes 4.0Ah battery and charger.
strengths: Light enough to hand off for perimeter and edge work while a stronger blower handles the open lawn
Vacuum mode is useful for bagging leaves along fence lines and beds
Lowest price of the four, good as a backup or second unit
limitations: 340 CFM alone is underpowered as the sole blower for a full acre
Battery doesn't share a platform with EGO or Ryobi if you're mixing brands
Best used alongside a stronger primary blower, not in place of one
features: 2-in-1 blower and vacuum with collection bag

products.name: Toro PowerJet F700 Corded Electric Leaf Blower
products.blurb: Key specs: 725 CFM airflow, 140 MPH air speed, 12-amp motor, No battery, unlimited runtime while plugged in.
strengths: 725 CFM is the strongest airflow of any blower in this list
Never runs out of charge mid-job as long as it's plugged in
Lightest blower here since there's no battery pack
limitations: Cord length is the real limiting factor on a large, open property
Impractical without outdoor outlets spaced around the yard
Louder at full power than the Ryobi Whisper Series
features: No battery, unlimited runtime while plugged in

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
